verdict.rationale: Programmatic access covers part of the product surface. The native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface give full data-plane access via SQL, and the official MCP server exposes tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring. CHKit adds typed commands to deploy schema and pipelines as code. However, nothing shows that UI-driven control-plane actions are exposed through a documented management API: creating or resizing clusters, configuring alert rules and webhook destinations, managing SSO/roles, data sharing, or point-in-time restore. missing for 10: a documented management/control-plane API, any evidence of UI-to-API parity for cluster lifecycle, alerting, access control and recovery operations, and independent corroboration.
